title: festuca stricta subsp. trachyphylla
intro: Festuca stricta subsp. trachyphylla, commonly known as Alpine Fescue, is a sub-species of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. Alpine Fescue is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Festuca stricta subsp. trachyphylla include sesquiterpenes, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
